paragraphs: Adda bar Avimi, before Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa; another reading, Abba bar Avimi. In Rav Nachman’s time. Rashi explains a sage known to recite mishnayot, forget them, and garble them. Eruvin 9, end of b: Rav Adda bar Avimi recited before Rabbi Chananyah; some say before Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa. (I think Pappi should be read, as at 12a.) See the new Talmud editions’ variants. Beitzah 26b: Adda bar Ukhmi, reciting, forgetting, and garbling mishnayot in Rav Nachman’s time. Jerusalem Talmud, Haro'eh, halakhah 3: Rabbi Tanchum told Rabbi Adda bar Avimi, etc.; Rabbi Chizkiyah told Rav Adda bar Avimi, etc. He said, “They said it following his teacher’s position.” Rabbi Mana asked Rabbi Chizkiyah who his teacher was (Rav Adda bar Abba’s); he answered, Rabbi Ze'ira. Ta'anit, chapter 1, halakhah 3, has the same subject as Rav Adda bar Ikhuma.
